description: A vanilla+ quality-of-life Fabric mod for Minecraft: backpack, compass minimap, world map, quest journal, inventory sorting, elytra slot, hopper filters and dozens of small fixes.

mods.name: Cassonade
mods.description: Quality-of-life tweaks and a more living world that stay close to vanilla: birds, waves and starry nights, a backpack, a compass minimap, a world map with waypoints, a clock with the weather forecast, an elytra slot, a quest journal, combat awareness, filtering hoppers, inventory sorting, right-click harvest, fairer recipes and a warmer interface.
